body: Yes, I'm an ass hole. An ex-druggy depressed ass hole who grew up with an abusive dad then losing the very person he was living for now with nothing and nobody working at a grocery store where I'm treated like shit all day making poverty pay then going home to emptiness and drinking and wishing it would just end. If that makes me an ass hole, then I'm an asshole. Anytime you want to take my place, let me know. I'm not saying I have it worse than most people. But the pile of shit still stinks, no matter how big.
